name: Emily
source:
role: Patient
disability: Left leg above knee amputee 
bio: Emily is a spirited young woman who lost her leg in a motorcycle accident. Despite her initial shyness and uncertainty, she is determined to regain her independence and confidence. Her journey with [mc] at the rehabilitation center is filled with challenges and breakthroughs as she learns to navigate her new reality.
